reuse.why: Extracts linkBankSyncAccount, downloadSingleAccountTransactions and listBankSyncAccounts from the Pluggy/Akahu copies and routes Fintegra through them, plus assertBankAccountNotLinked and findOrCreateBank; Pluggy's download and account listing are left as near-copies.

duplication.why: Adds no new copy and removes the Pluggy/Akahu link duplication, merging the Akahu/Fintegra balance branch; downloadPluggyAiTransactions and pluggyAiAccounts still mirror the new shared helpers.

placement.why: Shared link logic stays in accounts/app.ts, download logic in accounts/sync.ts, the URL in server-config.ts and the type in types/models, as the tree arranges them.

scope.why: Refactors the Pluggy and Akahu linkers (silently moving Akahu to Pluggy's fileId and ['transactions','accounts'] sync-event tables) and adds an unrequested fintegra-accounts listing method, beyond the server-side link/sync request.

maintainability.why: One link path for three providers is easier to own, but the helper hard-codes Pluggy's fileId and tables instead of parameterising the real per-provider variation.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Fintegra goes through the extracted linkBankSyncAccount, downloadSingleAccountTransactions and the shared balance branch.

disguised_duplication.where: The previous Akahu/Pluggy copies are replaced by shared helpers rather than reshaped.
